positions.as_written: Take the history: the stairs, the chair, the kneeling, the sitting, and whether the pain is at the front rather than at the sides.
Assess the range and specifically the painful arc, since patellofemoral wear hurts in the middle of the range rather than at the ends.
Assess the compartments, because combined disease is common and the treatment depends on which joints are involved.
